rules.name: netting-dev-vs-uat
rules.sql: SELECT i.indexname, i.tablename, i.indexdef, x.indisvalid AS valid, x.indisready AS ready FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.indexname IN ('idx_cdt_netting_open', 'idx_cdt_netting_security_open', 'idx_security_info_bu_sec_deriv')

SELECT i.indexname, i.tablename, i.indexdef, x.indisvalid AS valid, x.indisready AS ready FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.indexname IN ('idx_cdt_netting_open', 'idx_cdt_netting_security_open', 'idx_security_info_bu_sec_deriv')

expect.reason: all three netting indexes must exist in UAT
same index names and identical definitions in dev and UAT

rules.sql: SELECT id, author, exectype, md5sum, filename FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('create-idx-cdt-netting-open', 'create-idx-cdt-netting-security-open', 'create-idx-security-info-derivative-type') OR id LIKE '%netting_trade_view%' OR id LIKE '%netting-trade-view%'

SELECT id, author, exectype, md5sum, filename FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('create-idx-cdt-netting-open', 'create-idx-cdt-netting-security-open', 'create-idx-security-info-derivative-type') OR id LIKE '%netting_trade_view%' OR id LIKE '%netting-trade-view%'

expect.reason: the same netting changesets ran in both with the same checksum

rules.sql: SELECT 'netting_trade_view' AS view_name, md5(regexp_replace(pg_get_viewdef('opera.netting_trade_view'::regclass), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS definition_md5, length(pg_get_viewdef('opera.netting_trade_view'::regclass)) AS definition_length

SELECT 'netting_trade_view' AS view_name, md5(regexp_replace(pg_get_viewdef('opera.netting_trade_view'::regclass), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS definition_md5, length(pg_get_viewdef('opera.netting_trade_view'::regclass)) AS definition_length

expect.reason: same view definition in dev and UAT

rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, coalesce(deal_status, '(null)') AS deal_status, (deal_status = 'Live' OR deal_status IS NULL) AS inside_predicate, count(*) AS open_trades FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND coalesce(lots_to_be_netted, 0) <> 0 GROUP BY business_unit, coalesce(deal_status, '(null)'), (deal_status = 'Live' OR deal_status IS NULL)

SELECT business_unit, coalesce(deal_status, '(null)') AS deal_status, (deal_status = 'Live' OR deal_status IS NULL) AS inside_predicate, count(*) AS open_trades FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND coalesce(lots_to_be_netted, 0) <> 0 GROUP BY business_unit, coalesce(deal_status, '(null)'), (deal_status = 'Live' OR deal_status IS NULL)

expect.reason: no business unit or deal_status value exists in only one environment (a spelling or case difference shows here)

rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, deal_status, count(*) AS excluded_open_trades FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND coalesce(lots_to_be_netted, 0) <> 0 AND deal_status IS NOT NULL AND deal_status <> 'Live' GROUP BY business_unit, deal_status ORDER BY excluded_open_trades DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT business_unit, deal_status, count(*) AS excluded_open_trades FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND coalesce(lots_to_be_netted, 0) <> 0 AND deal_status IS NOT NULL AND deal_status <> 'Live' GROUP BY business_unit, deal_status ORDER BY excluded_open_trades DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.relname AS name, 'table' AS kind, s.n_live_tup AS rows_or_scans, s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze, s.seq_scan AS seq_scans FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'security_info_table') UNION ALL SELECT indexrelname, 'index', idx_scan, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM pg_stat_user_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND indexrelname IN ('idx_cdt_netting_open', 'idx_cdt_netting_security_open', 'idx_security_info_bu_sec_deriv') ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT s.relname AS name, 'table' AS kind, s.n_live_tup AS rows_or_scans, s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze, s.seq_scan AS seq_scans FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'security_info_table') UNION ALL SELECT indexrelname, 'index', idx_scan, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM pg_stat_user_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND indexrelname IN ('idx_cdt_netting_open', 'idx_cdt_netting_security_open', 'idx_security_info_bu_sec_deriv') ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT c.relname AS index_name, t.relname AS table_name, x.indisvalid AS valid, x.indisready AS ready FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND (NOT x.indisvalid OR NOT x.indisready)

expect.reason: no invalid or not-ready index in UAT
